proof_body:
by
  intro P a b hab
  have h1 : (P - Polynomial.C (P.eval a)).IsRoot a := by
    simp [Polynomial.IsRoot]
  obtain ⟨G, hG⟩ := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr h1
  have hab' : a - b ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr hab
  have hGb : (G - Polynomial.C ((P.eval a - P.eval b) / (a - b))).IsRoot b := by
    have hev := congrArg (Polynomial.eval b) hG
    simp only [Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, Polynomial.eval_C] at hev
    simp only [Polynomial.IsRoot, Polynomial.eval_sub, Polynomial.eval_C]
    rw [sub_eq_zero, eq_div_iff hab']
    linear_combination hev
  obtain ⟨Q, hQ⟩ := Polynomial.dvd_iff_isRoot.mpr hGb
  refine ⟨Q, ?_⟩
  linear_combination hG + (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) * hQ
target_source: ∀ (P : Polynomial ℝ) (a b : ℝ), a ≠ b → ∃ Q : Polynomial ℝ, P = (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C b) * Q + Polynomial.C ((P.eval a - P.eval b) / (a - b)) * (Polynomial.X - Polynomial.C a) + Polynomial.C (P.eval a)
